title: Cosmic Sorceress
description: A hooded female figure with glowing white eyes exhales swirling spectral energy from her mouth. Below her floats a luminous planet filled with colorful nebulae, constellations, and ghostly faces within its surface.
prompt: A mysterious hooded sorceress with pale skin and glowing white eyes breathes out streams of luminous blue and white spectral energy and smoke from her mouth. Below her, a large mystical planet floats in space, its surface filled with swirling colorful nebulae in green, pink and blue, dotted with stars and faint ghostly faces. Dark ethereal tendrils and flames swirl around the scene against a starry cosmic background, fantasy illustration style.
